newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission to present beef labelling plan.
newsitem.headline: Commission to present beef labelling plan.

text.p: European Union farm ministers are unlikely to agree on the Commission's plans for a beef labelling scheme at next week's farm Council, EU diplomats said on Friday.
"The Commission will present its proposals but there is a question of the effect the proposal to allow national labelling will have on the Single Market.
"The proposals for a voluntary system are running near the edge on that point," one diplomat said.

Some countries oppose the labelling plans in their present form because of the implications for single market law which bans the use of advertising which claims that one product is superior to another.
"Other countries want to see an even stronger labelling scheme in the interests of consumer safety," another said.

The British government does not see any need for labelling, its diplomats say, but they will be pressing for an urgent decision on improving the identification and registration of all bovine animals throughout the EU.
"Without a proper scheme for identifying animals there would be no way of verifying that claims made under a labelling scheme were true," a diplomat commented.
